# Awesome Agent Runtimes

A curated ownership map for agent cognition, supervision, continuity, isolation, and durable recovery.
Generated: 2026-08-21T19:24:21+00:00
Source: https://github.com/beejmaxx/awesome-agent-runtimes
Methodology: https://github.com/beejmaxx/awesome-agent-runtimes/blob/main/METHODOLOGY.md

## Agent cognition — coding harnesses

Agent brains that own the software-engineering loop, repository context, tools, and coding sessions.

- Aider (https://github.com/Aider-AI/aider): Terminal coding-agent runtime built around repository maps, editable worktrees, and Git-native sessions. [48,388 stars; local, coding, terminal, git]
- Cline (https://github.com/cline/cline): Autonomous coding-agent runtime available as an IDE extension, CLI, and embeddable SDK. [66,610 stars; local, library, coding, IDE, human-in-the-loop]
- Codex (https://github.com/openai/codex): Local coding-agent runtime and CLI with sandboxed command execution, approvals, and automation modes. [111,155 stars; local, coding, sandbox, terminal]
- Continue (https://github.com/continuedev/continue): Open-source coding-agent runtime spanning IDE, CLI, and continuous repository automation. [35,576 stars; local, self-hosted, coding, IDE, automation]
- Crush (https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush): Terminal coding-agent runtime with multi-model support, language-server integration, and extensible tools. [27,561 stars; local, coding, terminal, LSP]
- Gemini CLI (https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli): Terminal agent runtime for coding and general automation with tools, extensions, and MCP support. [106,600 stars; local, coding, terminal, MCP]
- Goose (https://github.com/aaif-goose/goose): Local extensible agent runtime that automates engineering tasks through MCP tools. [53,180 stars; local, coding, MCP, desktop]
- Kilo Code (https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode): Open-source coding agent for IDEs and the terminal with multiple models, specialized agents, and a managed cloud option. [26,966 stars; local, managed, coding, IDE, terminal]
- Open Interpreter (https://github.com/openinterpreter/openinterpreter): Local coding-agent runtime for open models with computer tools and executable workflows. [68,098 stars; local, coding, computer-use, local-models]
- OpenCode (https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode): Open-source coding-agent runtime for terminal, desktop, and IDE clients with parallel sessions. [199,938 stars; local, self-hosted, coding, client-server, multi-session]
- Pi (https://github.com/earendil-works/pi): Extensible coding-agent toolkit and CLI with persistent sessions, a unified model API, and UI libraries. [95,007 stars; local, library, coding, extensible, sessions]
- Qwen Code (https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code): Open-source terminal coding-agent runtime with tools, extensibility, and model-provider support. [27,266 stars; local, coding, terminal, tools]
- SWE-agent (https://github.com/SWE-agent/SWE-agent): Research-backed software-engineering agent runtime for resolving repository issues in controlled environments. [20,096 stars; local, self-hosted, coding, research, benchmark]

## Agent cognition — construction SDKs

Libraries for constructing model/tool loops, routing, state transitions, and multi-agent behavior.

- AgentScope (https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope): Developer framework for tool-using and multi-agent applications with runtime services. [29,168 stars; library, self-hosted, multi-agent, tools, distributed]
- Agno (https://github.com/agno-agi/agno): Python framework and AgentOS runtime for building, serving, and monitoring agent systems. [41,825 stars; library, self-hosted, managed, multi-agent, memory, observability]
- AutoGen (https://github.com/microsoft/autogen): Event-driven framework for conversational, tool-using, and multi-agent applications. [60,562 stars; library, self-hosted, multi-agent, event-driven, tools]
- CAMEL (https://github.com/camel-ai/camel): Multi-agent framework and research platform for agent societies, tools, memory, and task execution. [17,616 stars; library, self-hosted, multi-agent, research, memory]
- Claude Agent SDK (https://github.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-python): Anthropic's Python SDK for building agents with Claude Code's tools, sessions, and execution loop. [7,949 stars; library, self-hosted, tools, sessions, SDK]
- CrewAI (https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI): Role-based multi-agent runtime for coordinating crews and event-driven flows. [57,430 stars; library, self-hosted, managed, multi-agent, flows, observability]
- Deep Agents (https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents): Batteries-included agent harness with planning, filesystems, subagents, and long-term memory. [28,047 stars; library, self-hosted, planning, multi-agent, memory]
- Google Agent Development Kit (https://github.com/google/adk-python): Code-first agent framework with sessions, tools, evaluation, and local or managed runtime options. [21,218 stars; library, local, managed, multi-agent, evaluation, tools]
- LangChain (https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain): Established agent application framework with model, tool, middleware, and agent-loop abstractions. [144,729 stars; library, self-hosted, tools, middleware, ecosystem]
- LlamaIndex (https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index): Data-centric agent framework with workflows, tools, retrieval, memory, and multi-agent patterns. [51,791 stars; library, self-hosted, managed, data, workflows, retrieval]
- Mastra (https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra): TypeScript agent framework with workflows, memory, evaluation, and observability. [27,352 stars; library, self-hosted, managed, workflows, memory, observability]
- MetaGPT (https://github.com/FoundationAgents/MetaGPT): Multi-agent software-company framework that coordinates role-based agents through structured workflows. [69,936 stars; library, local, multi-agent, roles, workflows]
- Microsoft Agent Framework (https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework): Microsoft framework for building agents and graph workflows with middleware and state management. [13,027 stars; library, self-hosted, managed, workflows, multi-agent, middleware]
- OpenAI Agents SDK (https://github.com/openai/openai-agents-python): Lightweight Python runtime for agent loops, handoffs, guardrails, sessions, and tracing. [28,836 stars; library, handoffs, guardrails, tracing]
- Pydantic AI (https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai): Typed Python agent framework with tools, durable execution integrations, graphs, and evaluation. [19,432 stars; library, self-hosted, typed, durable, evaluation]
- Semantic Kernel (https://github.com/microsoft/semantic-kernel): Microsoft agent SDK with plugins, process orchestration, memory integrations, and multi-agent patterns. [28,477 stars; library, self-hosted, managed, plugins, multi-agent, enterprise]
- smolagents (https://github.com/huggingface/smolagents): Compact Hugging Face agent library centered on code-executing agents and composable tools. [28,920 stars; library, local, code-agents, tools, lightweight]

## Agent cognition — realtime voice and multimodal

Frameworks and runtimes for low-latency voice, video, telephony, and multimodal agent interactions.

- LiveKit Agents (https://github.com/livekit/agents): Server-side framework for realtime voice and multimodal agents with job dispatch, telephony, testing, and provider integrations. [13,126 stars; library, self-hosted, managed, voice, multimodal, realtime, telephony]
- Pipecat (https://github.com/pipecat-ai/pipecat): Python framework for realtime voice and multimodal agents with streaming pipelines and multi-agent coordination. [14,397 stars; library, self-hosted, managed, voice, multimodal, realtime, multi-agent]

## Agent cognition — browser and computer use

Harnesses and SDKs that own perception and action loops over browsers or desktop interfaces.

- Browser Use (https://github.com/browser-use/browser-use): Browser-agent framework and runtime for perception, action, sessions, and web task automation. [110,005 stars; library, local, managed, browser, automation, tools]
- Skyvern (https://github.com/Skyvern-AI/skyvern): Browser workflow runtime using visual and language-model reasoning instead of site-specific selectors. [22,822 stars; self-hosted, managed, browser, workflows, computer-use]
- Stagehand (https://github.com/browserbase/stagehand): Browser-agent SDK that combines natural-language actions with deterministic browser automation. [24,015 stars; library, self-hosted, managed, browser, automation, SDK]
- UFO (https://github.com/microsoft/UFO): Microsoft agent framework for automating Windows applications and multi-device desktop workflows. [9,536 stars; local, computer-use, desktop, multi-agent]

## Agent hosts and supervisors

Systems that start agents, provide environments and identity, stream events, supervise sessions, and recover failures.

- Agent Zero (https://github.com/agent0ai/agent-zero): General-purpose autonomous agent runtime with an interactive UI, subordinate agents, and executable tools. [18,922 stars; local, self-hosted, multi-agent, code-execution, memory]
- AionUi (https://github.com/iOfficeAI/AionUi): Cross-platform cowork application for supervising built-in and external CLI agents with remote access and persistent automation. [32,178 stars; local, self-hosted, control-plane, multi-agent, automation]
- AutoGPT (https://github.com/Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT): Platform for creating, deploying, and continuously running autonomous agents. [186,722 stars; self-hosted, managed, continuous, builder, marketplace]
- Claude Squad (https://github.com/smtg-ai/claude-squad): Terminal supervisor for running multiple coding agents concurrently in isolated Git workspaces. [8,347 stars; local, supervisor, coding, worktrees]
- Cloudflare Agents (https://github.com/cloudflare/agents): Stateful agent SDK built on Durable Objects with identity, persistence, scheduling, and realtime connections. [5,471 stars; library, managed, stateful, serverless, realtime]
- DeerFlow (https://github.com/bytedance/deer-flow): Long-horizon agent harness with sandboxes, memory, skills, subagents, and a messaging gateway. [80,488 stars; local, self-hosted, long-running, skills, multi-agent]
- Gas Town (https://github.com/gastownhall/gastown): Multi-agent workspace manager with persistent work tracking, agent identities, mailboxes, handoffs, and Git worktrees. [17,707 stars; local, supervisor, work-state, multi-agent, worktrees]
- OpenHands (https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands): Software-development agent platform with a runtime for executing tools in isolated workspaces. [84,725 stars; local, self-hosted, managed, coding, sandbox, multi-agent]
- T3 Code (https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code): Local control plane for operating existing coding-agent CLIs from web, desktop, and mobile clients. [19,928 stars; local, self-hosted, control-plane, coding, remote-access]

## Durable orchestration

Workflow and state-machine substrates for checkpoints, retries, waits, schedules, recovery, and reconciliation.

- Hatchet (https://github.com/hatchet-dev/hatchet): Task orchestration platform for durable workflows, queues, retries, concurrency, and monitoring. [7,773 stars; self-hosted, managed, durable, workflows, observability]
- Inngest (https://github.com/inngest/inngest): Event-driven durable execution platform for step functions, scheduling, retries, and agent workflows. [5,752 stars; self-hosted, managed, durable, event-driven, workflows]
- LangGraph (https://github.com/langchain-ai/langgraph): Graph-based runtime for stateful, durable, and human-in-the-loop agent workflows. [40,186 stars; library, self-hosted, managed, durable, human-in-the-loop, graph]
- Temporal (https://github.com/temporalio/temporal): General durable-execution platform commonly used to make long-running agent workflows resilient. [22,445 stars; self-hosted, managed, durable, workflows, recovery]
- Trigger.dev (https://github.com/triggerdotdev/trigger.dev): TypeScript background-job platform for long-running AI tasks with retries, queues, and monitoring. [16,084 stars; self-hosted, managed, durable, background-jobs, observability]

## Personal agent OSes and continuity

Long-lived personal agents that own identity, sessions, memory, schedules, connections, or notifications across interactions.

- ElizaOS (https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza): Agent operating system with persistent identities, multi-agent coordination, and a plugin ecosystem. [19,114 stars; local, self-hosted, multi-agent, plugins, memory]
- Hermes Agent (https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent): Persistent agent runtime with learned skills, cross-session memory, schedules, messaging gateways, and subagents. [233,923 stars; local, self-hosted, self-improving, skills, scheduler, multi-agent]
- Letta (https://github.com/letta-ai/letta): Stateful agent server centered on persistent memory, context management, and long-lived identities. [24,332 stars; self-hosted, managed, memory, server, stateful]
- Nanobot (https://github.com/HKUDS/nanobot): Lightweight self-hosted personal agent with tools, memory, MCP, automations, and chat integrations. [47,260 stars; local, self-hosted, personal-agent, MCP, automation]
- NanoClaw (https://github.com/nanocoai/nanoclaw): Container-isolated personal agent runtime with messaging channels, memory, skills, and scheduled jobs. [30,588 stars; local, self-hosted, personal-agent, containers, scheduler]
- OpenClaw (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw): Personal agent runtime with messaging channels, schedules, memory, skills, and tool execution. [387,039 stars; local, self-hosted, personal-agent, scheduler, tools]

## Execution and isolation

Sandboxes and controlled environments in which agents run code, commands, browsers, and tools.

- CUA (https://github.com/trycua/cua): Cross-platform computer-use infrastructure with background drivers, agent-ready VM and container sandboxes, and fleet tooling. [21,771 stars; library, local, managed, computer-use, sandbox, virtualization]
- E2B (https://github.com/e2b-dev/E2B): Open-source infrastructure for running agent-generated code in isolated cloud sandboxes. [13,507 stars; self-hosted, managed, sandbox, code-execution, API]
- Microsandbox (https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox): Self-hosted microVM platform for secure, fast, and isolated user or agent code execution. [7,845 stars; local, self-hosted, microVM, isolation, code-execution]

Platforms for building, packaging, exposing, and operating agent applications.

- Dify (https://github.com/langgenius/dify): Visual platform for building and operating agentic applications, workflows, and model services. [153,138 stars; self-hosted, managed, low-code, workflows, observability]
- Langflow (https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow): Visual Python framework for composing and serving agent workflows with an API. [153,536 stars; local, self-hosted, managed, low-code, builder, API]
